accepted: All-time volume-uniform Gaussian spatial approximation on infinite-dimensional onsite blocks; reverse additionally proves inverse and full-generator bounded-commutator approximation by independently retaining every crossing term.
limitations: Directions use distinct collars, durations and numerical instances; their specific regional sizes/errors cannot be mixed.
The telescoping decomposition has exponential diameter control but does not certify the existing exponential support-cardinality interaction norm.
Failed cardinality upper majorant is not actual divergence or impossibility of every connected-support decomposition.
Local residual/inverse approximation does not give later-diagonal stability, exact source inversion, homogeneous numerical gap or continuum construction.
Norm finite-volume limit for an observable does not imply norm continuity in time on all local B(H) or norm convergence of full propagators.
review: separate model-agent skeptic; not external peer review
next_loop_recommendation: Freeze a candidate connected-support or time-partition construction aimed at the original exponential support-cardinality norm, then establish that norm with all ordered multiplicities or identify the precise failed certificate. Do not relabel the proved diameter norm as the required stability norm.
